recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-32864 unless Pharmacy later opens a broader revision of medication list guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-32864 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to add a Medications Module overview section explaining how Pharmacy resources should be used for medication reconciliation, based on Pharmacy Medication Reconciliation List / Medication List Guidance content.
initial_application: Commit ece63351c6107ee2d837bd8bdc64871ad186dc4c explicitly mentioned FHIR-32864 and added the Medication Reconciliation List section to source/medications-module.html; it was merged by 0491ec11c00a0d5e60030e84ffd191391dad9e5b. Current source still contains the section, updated to current resource naming with MedicationStatement.
additional_context: source/medications-module.html is the active Medications module page in source/hierarchy.xml, and the relevant medication resources are active in source/fhir.ini. Pharmacy Confluence records show the Medication List Guidance project and January 2022 tracker review including FHIR-32864. The Zulip Medication overview thread supports context-dependent medication list/reconciliation guidance using List and multiple medication resources. Later FHIR-53486 page reorganization is already represented on the combined branch and preserved this guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Medication Reconciliation List section already covers the reconciliation process, transition-of-care contexts, source medication information, representation with MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, MedicationAdministration, and MedicationStatement, context-dependent variation, and patient/clinician availability.

related_jiras.note: The historical implementation commit mentioned both FHIR-24100 and FHIR-32864; FHIR-24100 is a broader Pharmacy workflow/resource review and was not independently decided here.
Later Applied/Persuasive R6 work reorganized the Medications Module page, preserved the medication reconciliation guidance, and is already represented on the combined branch.
